experiments/docs/copy-guard.ts

Copy-protection layer for the docs source viewer.
Source src/experiments/docs/copy-guard.ts
UX surface Boot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

(module scope)

Disposer bag — each attach returns the remover.

guardToast

The translated toast body — resolved by the caller from the docs-portal CMS component node; falls back to the English literal so a missing translation never silently swallows the warning.

hijackClipboard

Rewrites an in-flight clipboard payload to the GitHub repo URL — the paste target receives the repo link instead of protected source text.

attachCopyGuard

Wires every guard listener onto root (typically the viewer container or the component shadow root). isProtected gates interception so the guard only bites while a protected page (source-code file) is open — normal browsing of docs/reports keeps full clipboard freedom.

  • @param root Element/ShadowRoot to attach to.
  • @param isProtected Whether the current view is guarded right now.
  • @param getPath Returns the current docs path for telemetry.
  • @param toastText Localized toast message getter.
  • @returns Disposer removing every listener.
